title: Ospreay breaks from Okada & builds an Empire
summary: Will Ospreay rejects his place beneath Okada in CHAOS. A new faction and a heavier, more ruthless approach put him on the road to the world championship.

chapters.title: Ospreay turns on his mentor
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats Okada with outside help and attacks him afterward.
chapters.context: Great-O-Khan and Bea Priestley help establish a new alliance outside CHAOS.

chapters.title: Okada wins the first reckoning
chapters.context: The Dome setback prevents the betrayal from becoming an immediate conquest of his former leader.

chapters.title: The Empire gains a world champion
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats Ibushi for the IWGP World Heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The challenger reaches the summit through a different opponent, giving his breakaway faction its defining early achievement.
